package student

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
)

const (
	marketplacePreviewRuntimeEnv  = "MARKETPLACE_PREVIEW_RUNTIME_JSON"
	marketplacePreviewVariantsEnv = "MARKETPLACE_PREVIEW_VARIANTS_JSON"
	marketplacePreviewSlug        = "marketplace-beginner-junior-pilot"
	marketplacePreviewRevisionID  = "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001"
)

type marketplacePreviewAdminVariantEnvelope struct {
	Items []marketplacePreviewAdminVariant `json:"items"`
}

type marketplacePreviewAdminVariant struct {
	ID                              string          `json:"id"`
	Code                            string          `json:"code"`
	ReviewPolicyJSON                json.RawMessage `json:"review_policy_json"`
	AIReviewContractJSON            json.RawMessage `json:"ai_review_contract_json"`
	MentorRubricJSON                json.RawMessage `json:"mentor_rubric_json"`
	IntegrationTestSuiteRef         *string         `json:"integration_test_suite_ref"`
	IntegrationReferenceSolutionRef *string         `json:"integration_reference_solution_ref"`
	IntegrationNegativeFixtureRefs  []string        `json:"integration_negative_fixture_refs"`
	VerificationRunnerRef           *string         `json:"verification_runner_ref"`
}

type marketplacePreviewStyleAssertion struct {
	Selector    string   `json:"selector"`
	Property    string   `json:"property"`
	AnyOfValues []string `json:"anyOfValues"`
	NonZero     bool     `json:"nonZero"`
}

type marketplacePreviewStyleAlternative struct {
	Assertions []marketplacePreviewStyleAssertion `json:"assertions"`
}

type marketplacePreviewStyleAnyOf struct {
	ID           string                               `json:"id"`
	Alternatives []marketplacePreviewStyleAlternative `json:"alternatives"`
}

type marketplacePreviewValidationContract struct {
	Stages []struct {
		ID     string `json:"id"`
		Engine string `json:"engine"`
		Checks struct {
			ComputedStyleAnyOf []marketplacePreviewStyleAnyOf `json:"computedStyleAnyOf"`
		} `json:"checks"`
	} `json:"stages"`
}

func TestMarketplaceV1PreviewLifecycleFromCatalog(t *testing.T) {
	runtimePayload := []byte(os.Getenv(marketplacePreviewRuntimeEnv))
	variantsPayload := []byte(os.Getenv(marketplacePreviewVariantsEnv))
	if len(runtimePayload) == 0 || len(variantsPayload) == 0 {
		t.Skipf("set %s and %s to run the read-only Marketplace preview E2E", marketplacePreviewRuntimeEnv, marketplacePreviewVariantsEnv)
	}

	assertMarketplaceRuntimeHidesPrivateEvaluation(t, runtimePayload)
	runtimeContext := decodeMarketplacePreviewRuntime(t, runtimePayload)
	adminVariants := decodeMarketplacePreviewAdminVariants(t, variantsPayload)
	assertMarketplaceDraftIdentity(t, runtimeContext)
	assertMarketplaceAdminEvaluation(t, runtimeContext, adminVariants)

	previewRuntime := runtimeContext
	previewRuntime.RevisionID = marketplacePreviewRevisionID
	previewRuntime.RevisionNumber = 1
	previewRuntime.PracticeTask.Status = domain.PracticeTaskStatusActive
	previewRuntime.PracticeTask.Visibility = domain.PracticeTaskVisibilityPublic

	expectedMilestones := map[string]int{
		"html-beginner":      1,
		"html-css-beginner":  2,
		"html-css-js-junior": 3,
	}
	selectedByCode := make(map[string][]domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone, len(expectedMilestones))
	lessonsByCode := make(map[string][]string, len(expectedMilestones))
	for code, expectedCount := range expectedMilestones {
		variant := marketplaceVariantByCode(t, previewRuntime.SolutionVariants, code)
		selected := marketplaceSelectedMilestones(t, previewRuntime, variant)
		if len(selected) != expectedCount {
			t.Fatalf("variant %s selected %d milestones, want %d", code, len(selected), expectedCount)
		}
		assertMarketplaceMilestoneRuntime(t, code, selected)
		selectedByCode[code] = selected
		lessonsByCode[code] = marketplaceLessonRoute(selected)
		assertMarketplaceMaterialization(t, previewRuntime, variant, expectedCount)
	}

	assertMarketplaceLessonReuse(t, lessonsByCode)
	assertMarketplaceCSSSpacingContract(t, selectedByCode["html-css-beginner"])
	assertMarketplaceFinalReviewFlow(
		t,
		previewRuntime,
		marketplaceVariantByCode(t, previewRuntime.SolutionVariants, "html-css-js-junior"),
		selectedByCode["html-css-js-junior"],
		adminVariants,
	)
}

func assertMarketplaceCSSSpacingContract(t *testing.T, milestones []domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone) {
	t.Helper()
	for _, milestone := range milestones {
		var contract marketplacePreviewValidationContract
		if err := json.Unmarshal(milestone.ValidationContractJSON, &contract); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("decode Marketplace validation contract for milestone %s: %v", milestone.ID, err)
		}
		for _, stage := range contract.Stages {
			if stage.ID != "marketplace-card-spacing" {
				continue
			}
			if stage.Engine != "browser.runtime" || len(stage.Checks.ComputedStyleAnyOf) != 1 {
				t.Fatalf("Marketplace CSS spacing stage is incomplete: %#v", stage)
			}
			group := stage.Checks.ComputedStyleAnyOf[0]
			if group.ID != "catalog-spacing" || len(group.Alternatives) < 3 {
				t.Fatalf("Marketplace CSS alternatives are incomplete: %#v", group)
			}
			if !hasDisplayAndNonZeroGapAlternative(group.Alternatives) || !hasNonZeroCardMarginAlternative(group.Alternatives) {
				t.Fatalf("Marketplace CSS contract must accept an effective grid/flex gap or card margin: %#v", group)
			}
			return
		}
	}
	t.Fatal("Marketplace CSS runtime contract lacks marketplace-card-spacing")
}

func hasDisplayAndNonZeroGapAlternative(alternatives []marketplacePreviewStyleAlternative) bool {
	for _, alternative := range alternatives {
		hasDisplay := false
		hasGap := false
		for _, assertion := range alternative.Assertions {
			if assertion.Selector == "main" && assertion.Property == "display" && len(assertion.AnyOfValues) >= 2 {
				hasDisplay = true
			}
			if assertion.Selector == "main" && (assertion.Property == "row-gap" || assertion.Property == "column-gap") && assertion.NonZero {
				hasGap = true
			}
		}
		if hasDisplay && hasGap {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func hasNonZeroCardMarginAlternative(alternatives []marketplacePreviewStyleAlternative) bool {
	for _, alternative := range alternatives {
		for _, assertion := range alternative.Assertions {
			if assertion.Selector == ".product-card" && len(assertion.Property) > len("margin-") && assertion.Property[:len("margin-")] == "margin-" && assertion.NonZero {
				return true
			}
		}
	}
	return false
}

func decodeMarketplacePreviewRuntime(t *testing.T, payload []byte) domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeContext {
	t.Helper()
	var runtimeContext domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeContext
	if err := json.Unmarshal(payload, &runtimeContext); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("decode Marketplace runtime context: %v", err)
	}
	return runtimeContext
}

func decodeMarketplacePreviewAdminVariants(t *testing.T, payload []byte) []marketplacePreviewAdminVariant {
	t.Helper()
	var envelope marketplacePreviewAdminVariantEnvelope
	if err := json.Unmarshal(payload, &envelope); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("decode Marketplace admin variants: %v", err)
	}
	if len(envelope.Items) != 3 {
		t.Fatalf("Marketplace admin catalog exposes %d variants, want 3", len(envelope.Items))
	}
	return envelope.Items
}

func assertMarketplaceDraftIdentity(t *testing.T, runtimeContext domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeContext) {
	t.Helper()
	if runtimeContext.PracticeTask.Slug != marketplacePreviewSlug {
		t.Fatalf("runtime slug = %q, want %q", runtimeContext.PracticeTask.Slug, marketplacePreviewSlug)
	}
	if runtimeContext.RevisionID != "" || runtimeContext.RevisionNumber != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("working catalog was unexpectedly published: revision=%q number=%d", runtimeContext.RevisionID, runtimeContext.RevisionNumber)
	}
	if runtimeContext.PracticeTask.Status != domain.PracticeTaskStatusDraft || runtimeContext.PracticeTask.Visibility != domain.PracticeTaskVisibilityPrivate {
		t.Fatalf("working catalog must remain draft/private, got status=%d visibility=%d", runtimeContext.PracticeTask.Status, runtimeContext.PracticeTask.Visibility)
	}
	if len(runtimeContext.PracticeTaskParts) != 2 || len(runtimeContext.PracticeTaskMilestones) != 3 || len(runtimeContext.SolutionVariants) != 3 {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected Marketplace shape: parts=%d milestones=%d variants=%d", len(runtimeContext.PracticeTaskParts), len(runtimeContext.PracticeTaskMilestones), len(runtimeContext.SolutionVariants))
	}
}

func assertMarketplaceRuntimeHidesPrivateEvaluation(t *testing.T, payload []byte) {
	t.Helper()
	for _, forbidden := range [][]byte{
		[]byte(`"ai_review_contract_json"`),
		[]byte(`"mentor_rubric_json"`),
		[]byte(`"integration_test_suite_ref"`),
		[]byte(`"integration_reference_solution_ref"`),
		[]byte(`"integration_negative_fixture_refs"`),
		[]byte(`"verification_runner_ref"`),
	} {
		if bytes.Contains(payload, forbidden) {
			t.Fatalf("student runtime leaked private field %s", forbidden)
		}
	}
}

func assertMarketplaceAdminEvaluation(t *testing.T, runtimeContext domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeContext, items []marketplacePreviewAdminVariant) {
	t.Helper()
	for _, runtimeVariant := range runtimeContext.SolutionVariants {
		adminVariant := marketplaceAdminVariantByID(t, items, runtimeVariant.ID)
		if adminVariant.Code != runtimeVariant.Code {
			t.Fatalf("variant %s code mismatch: runtime=%q admin=%q", runtimeVariant.ID, runtimeVariant.Code, adminVariant.Code)
		}
		if !bytes.Equal(bytes.TrimSpace(adminVariant.ReviewPolicyJSON), bytes.TrimSpace(runtimeVariant.ReviewPolicyJSON)) {
			t.Fatalf("variant %s public review policy differs from the authoring policy", runtimeVariant.Code)
		}
		var contract domain.PracticeTaskAIReviewContract
		if err := json.Unmarshal(adminVariant.AIReviewContractJSON, &contract); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("variant %s AI review contract is invalid: %v", runtimeVariant.Code, err)
		}
		if contract.Version != 1 || contract.TemplateCode == "" || contract.ResponseSchemaCode == "" || len(contract.WhatToCheck) == 0 || len(contract.WhatNotToCheck) == 0 || len(contract.AllowedVariations) == 0 || len(contract.UncertainWhen) == 0 {
			t.Fatalf("variant %s AI review contract is incomplete: %#v", runtimeVariant.Code, contract)
		}
		if !jsonObjectHasValues(adminVariant.MentorRubricJSON) || adminVariant.IntegrationTestSuiteRef == nil || adminVariant.IntegrationReferenceSolutionRef == nil || len(adminVariant.IntegrationNegativeFixtureRefs) == 0 || adminVariant.VerificationRunnerRef == nil {
			t.Fatalf("variant %s private mentor/integration bundle is incomplete", runtimeVariant.Code)
		}
	}
}

func marketplaceVariantByCode(t *testing.T, items []domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeVariant, code string) domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeVariant {
	t.Helper()
	for _, item := range items {
		if item.Code == code {
			return item
		}
	}
	t.Fatalf("Marketplace variant %q not found", code)
	return domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeVariant{}
}

func marketplaceAdminVariantByID(t *testing.T, items []marketplacePreviewAdminVariant, id string) marketplacePreviewAdminVariant {
	t.Helper()
	for _, item := range items {
		if item.ID == id {
			return item
		}
	}
	t.Fatalf("Marketplace admin variant %q not found", id)
	return marketplacePreviewAdminVariant{}
}

func marketplaceSelectedMilestones(t *testing.T, runtimeContext domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeContext, variant domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeVariant) []domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone {
	t.Helper()
	selected, err := milestonesForSolutionVariant(runtimeContext.PracticeTaskMilestones, variant)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("select Marketplace variant %s milestones: %v", variant.Code, err)
	}
	return selected
}

func assertMarketplaceMilestoneRuntime(t *testing.T, variantCode string, items []domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone) {
	t.Helper()
	for _, item := range items {
		if !item.IsActive || item.PracticeTaskMilestoneID == "" || item.PracticeTaskPartID == "" {
			t.Fatalf("variant %s contains unusable milestone %#v", variantCode, item)
		}
		if !jsonObjectHasValues(item.ValidationContractJSON) || !jsonObjectHasValues(item.StarterWorkspaceJSON) || !jsonObjectHasValues(item.RuntimeProfileJSON) {
			t.Fatalf("variant %s milestone %s lacks contract, starter, or runtime profile", variantCode, item.ID)
		}
		if len(item.LessonBindings) != 1 {
			t.Fatalf("variant %s milestone %s has %d lesson bindings, want 1", variantCode, item.ID, len(item.LessonBindings))
		}
		lesson := item.LessonBindings[0]
		if lesson.CourseID == "" || lesson.LessonID == "" || lesson.Requirement != domain.PracticeTaskLessonRequirementRequired || lesson.StepTitle == "" || lesson.StepInstructions == "" {
			t.Fatalf("variant %s milestone %s has incomplete project lesson step: %#v", variantCode, item.ID, lesson)
		}
	}
}

func assertMarketplaceMaterialization(t *testing.T, runtimeContext domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeContext, variant domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeVariant, expected int) {
	t.Helper()
	repositoryStub := &materializationRepositoryStub{}
	useCase := StudentUseCase{
		Catalog:  materializationCatalogStub{runtimeContext: runtimeContext, revisionID: runtimeContext.RevisionID},
		Students: repositoryStub,
	}
	created, err := useCase.CreateStudentPracticeTask(context.Background(), "marketplace-preview-student", runtimeContext.PracticeTask.ID, variant.ID)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("materialize Marketplace variant %s: %v", variant.Code, err)
	}
	if created.PracticeTaskRevisionID != marketplacePreviewRevisionID || created.PracticeTaskSolutionVariantID != variant.ID {
		t.Fatalf("variant %s did not pin preview revision and selected route: %#v", variant.Code, created)
	}
	if len(repositoryStub.createdMilestones) != expected {
		t.Fatalf("variant %s materialized %d milestones, want %d", variant.Code, len(repositoryStub.createdMilestones), expected)
	}
}

func marketplaceLessonRoute(items []domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone) []string {
	result := make([]string, 0, len(items))
	for _, item := range items {
		for _, lesson := range item.LessonBindings {
			result = append(result, lesson.LessonID)
		}
	}
	return result
}

func assertMarketplaceLessonReuse(t *testing.T, routes map[string][]string) {
	t.Helper()
	html := routes["html-beginner"]
	css := routes["html-css-beginner"]
	junior := routes["html-css-js-junior"]
	if len(html) != 1 || len(css) != 2 || len(junior) != 3 {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected Marketplace lesson routes: html=%v css=%v junior=%v", html, css, junior)
	}
	if html[0] != css[0] || html[0] != junior[0] || css[1] != junior[1] {
		t.Fatalf("progressive variants do not reuse completed lessons: html=%v css=%v junior=%v", html, css, junior)
	}
}

func assertMarketplaceFinalReviewFlow(
	t *testing.T,
	runtimeContext domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeContext,
	variant domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeVariant,
	selected []domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone,
	adminVariants []marketplacePreviewAdminVariant,
) {
	t.Helper()
	adminVariant := marketplaceAdminVariantByID(t, adminVariants, variant.ID)
	evaluation := domain.PracticeTaskEvaluationContext{Variants: []domain.PracticeTaskVariantEvaluation{{
		PracticeTaskSolutionVariantID:   variant.ID,
		AIReviewContractJSON:            adminVariant.AIReviewContractJSON,
		MentorRubricJSON:                adminVariant.MentorRubricJSON,
		IntegrationTestSuiteRef:         adminVariant.IntegrationTestSuiteRef,
		IntegrationReferenceSolutionRef: adminVariant.IntegrationReferenceSolutionRef,
		IntegrationNegativeFixtureRefs:  append([]string(nil), adminVariant.IntegrationNegativeFixtureRefs...),
		VerificationRunnerRef:           adminVariant.VerificationRunnerRef,
	}}}

	now := time.Now().UTC()
	answerID := "marketplace-preview-final-answer"
	sandboxID := "marketplace-preview-sandbox"
	studentMilestones := make([]domain.StudentPracticeTaskMilestone, 0, len(selected))
	for index, item := range selected {
		studentMilestone := domain.StudentPracticeTaskMilestone{
			ID:                          fmt.Sprintf("marketplace-preview-milestone-%d", index+1),
			StudentPracticeTaskID:       "marketplace-preview-project",
			PracticeTaskPartMilestoneID: item.ID,
			PracticeTaskPartID:          item.PracticeTaskPartID,
			PracticeTaskMilestoneID:     item.PracticeTaskMilestoneID,
			Status:                      domain.StudentMilestoneStatusPassed,
			BestResultJSON:              json.RawMessage(`{"passed":true}`),
			PassedAt:                    &now,
		}
		if index == len(selected)-1 {
			studentMilestone.TaskAnswerID = &answerID
		}
		studentMilestones = append(studentMilestones, studentMilestone)
	}

	repositoryStub := &finalReviewRepositoryStub{
		project: domain.StudentPracticeTask{
			ID:                            "marketplace-preview-project",
			StudentID:                     "marketplace-preview-student",
			PracticeTaskID:                runtimeContext.PracticeTask.ID,
			PracticeTaskRevisionID:        runtimeContext.RevisionID,
			PracticeTaskSolutionVariantID: variant.ID,
			Status:                        domain.StudentPracticeTaskStatusReadyForReview,
			ActiveSandboxID:               &sandboxID,
		},
		milestones: studentMilestones,
		artifacts: []domain.StudentPracticeTaskArtifact{{
			ID:                    "marketplace-preview-artifact",
			StudentPracticeTaskID: "marketplace-preview-project",
			StorageFileID:         "marketplace-preview-storage",
			MetaJSON:              json.RawMessage(`{"task_answer_id":"marketplace-preview-final-answer"}`),
			CreatedAt:             now,
		}},
	}
	validation := &finalReviewValidationStub{passed: true}
	useCase := StudentUseCase{
		Catalog:  finalReviewCatalogStub{runtime: runtimeContext, evaluation: evaluation},
		Students: repositoryStub,
		Sandbox: finalReviewSandboxStub{files: []domain.WorkspaceFile{
			{Path: "index.html", Content: `<main><article class="product-card"><button>Добавить в корзину</button></article></main>`},
			{Path: "styles.css", Content: `main{display:grid;gap:1rem}.product-card{border:1px solid;padding:1rem}`},
			{Path: "script.js", Content: `document.querySelector("button").addEventListener("click", updateCart)`},
		}},
		Validation: validation,
		AIReview:   nil,
	}

	review, err := useCase.SubmitPracticeTaskFinalReview(context.Background(), repositoryStub.project.StudentID, repositoryStub.project.ID)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("submit Marketplace final review: %v", err)
	}
	if validation.calls != len(selected) {
		t.Fatalf("final review revalidated %d milestones, want %d", validation.calls, len(selected))
	}
	if review.Status != domain.PracticeTaskFinalReviewStatusPendingMentor || review.AIStatus != domain.PracticeTaskAIReviewStatusUnavailable {
		t.Fatalf("optional AI outage did not fall back to mentor: %#v", review)
	}
	queue, err := useCase.ListPendingPracticeTaskFinalReviews(context.Background(), 10, 0)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("load Marketplace mentor queue: %v", err)
	}
	if len(queue) != 1 || !bytes.Equal(bytes.TrimSpace(queue[0].MentorRubricJSON), bytes.TrimSpace(adminVariant.MentorRubricJSON)) {
		t.Fatalf("mentor queue did not preserve the Marketplace rubric: %#v", queue)
	}

	score := 100.0
	approved, err := useCase.ReviewPracticeTaskFinalSubmission(context.Background(), "marketplace-preview-mentor", repositoryStub.project.ID, review.ID, PracticeTaskMentorDecision{Passed: true, Score: &score})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("approve Marketplace final review: %v", err)
	}
	if approved.Status != domain.PracticeTaskFinalReviewStatusPassed || approved.MentorStatus != domain.PracticeTaskMentorReviewStatusPassed || repositoryStub.project.Status != domain.StudentPracticeTaskStatusCompleted || repositoryStub.project.CompletedAt == nil {
		t.Fatalf("mentor approval did not complete Marketplace: review=%#v project=%#v", approved, repositoryStub.project)
	}
}

func jsonObjectHasValues(value json.RawMessage) bool {
	var object map[string]any
	return json.Unmarshal(value, &object) == nil && len(object) > 0
}
